images.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve, costume-preserving character variants.
Asset type: character customization concept lineup for the original game VEILBOUND HUNTERS.
Primary request: Expand the approved male hunter costume into FOUR adult character appearance presets, demonstrating women, several skin tones and several realistic body shapes, while keeping exactly the same recognizable outfit language. This is design reference artwork, not a screenshot or finished 3D asset.
Input images: image 1 is the adopted original art style board (palette/material style only); image 2 is the approved male hunter full-body outfit and the identity of the fourth figure.
Layout: wide landscape illustration. Exactly FOUR full-body adults in one evenly spaced row, each head to boot soles fully visible on the SAME ground line, equal overall stature and camera scale, clear space between them. Relaxed front-facing inspection pose, hands slightly clear of the waist so body and pouch are readable. Pale warm gray plain studio background, soft diffuse neutral light.
Left to right:
1. Adult woman in her late twenties with light warm skin, a balanced athletic build, an individual mature face and medium brown hair tied in a compact low braid.
2. Adult woman with deep rich brown skin, a strongly athletic muscular build with visibly substantial shoulders and arms, an original mature face and short dense coiled hair. Confident neutral expression.
3. Adult woman with medium warm brown skin and a naturally fuller soft body, broader waist and fuller upper arms/thighs, mature face and dark wavy hair gathered into a practical low bun. Preserve natural proportions, dignity and practical tailoring.
4. The approved male hunter A from the supplied reference: short tousled chestnut hair, same adult face and lean athletic build, original light-tan skin. Preserve his identity.
ALL FOUR share the same practical, fully covered outfit: muted gray-moss green short mantle ending around the lower shoulder blades, hood lowered; off-white rolled-sleeve woven shirt; the same brown crossed leather harness with two small circular bronze front clasps; wide overlapping leather waist belts; green front apron over layered off-white shirt hem; brown trousers; leather forearm bracers and bare hands; brown tall boots with flat functional soles and folded cuffs. Exactly one small leather pouch on the wearer's anatomical RIGHT hip. Same materials and level of protection for every figure.
Tailor shirt, belt, trousers and mantle to each body; do not simply recolor the same body or squeeze the characters into identical waist measurements. Female forms should read through natural clothing fit without cleavage or exposed midriff. Keep arm/leg reach and total stature visually comparable so these can share a game animation rig. No weapons, no helmet, no new jewelry, no added armor or capes.
Style: polished original semi-real fantasy game concept painting, matching the attached handcrafted thick cloth, worn leather and restrained bronze. Natural faces, readable large shape differences, believable hands and boots. No text, labels, borders, watermark, statistics, icons or scenery. Do not imply that skin tone is linked to a particular build or role; these are merely four freely mixable examples.

images.initial_prompt: Create a professional original fantasy game character HAIRSTYLE REFERENCE SHEET for VEILBOUND HUNTERS. Match the semi-real painterly game art style, gray moss / cream cloth / dark brown leather costume and realistic adult proportions of the supplied image. Use ONLY the FIRST woman at the left of the provided lineup as the face identity for ALL EIGHT portraits. She is an adult, with the same light warm skin, exact same face, eyes, eyebrows, neck and shoulder width in every panel. Same calm expression, same very subtle three-quarter front angle, same scale, same soft even studio light. Two rows of four clearly separated head-and-shoulders portraits on a plain warm pale gray background, generous margins, clean consistent grid. All eight have identical natural dark chestnut hair color; only hairstyle changes. No face diversity across this sheet. No helmets. No weapons. No text, no numbers, no labels, no borders, no arrows. Each entire hair silhouette fully visible with no cropping; enough area behind neck to see tied styles. TOP ROW LEFT TO RIGHT: (1) tousled short layered hair, slightly center parted, distinct forehead lock, the original male hunter A hairstyle transferred naturally to this woman's head; (2) neat straight side-parted short crop, tucked at ears; (3) straight ear-length bob, ends above jaw, hair clear of collar; (4) straight hair tied low at nape into a short compact ponytail, a simple plain leather tie. BOTTOM ROW LEFT TO RIGHT: (5) short loose curly hair made of readable ringlet clusters, compact silhouette; (6) curly hair in a small low nape bun, a few natural temple curls, visible enough from the consistent subtle three-quarter view; (7) short dense tightly coiled hair with a compact rounded silhouette and natural hairline; (8) close-to-scalp front-to-back braided hair gathered into a very short neat tuck at nape, visible braid structure on the top and sides. Retain her identical face across all eight and preserve each hair texture as distinct. Practical hunter hairstyles, no jewelry, no beads or decorative accessories, no fantastical ears. This is a hairstyle concept sheet for later 3D modeling, not a sprite sheet. Do not copy all the different people from the reference, repeat only the first woman's face.
images.refinement_prompt: Edit this exact 2-row by 4-column hairstyle reference sheet. Preserve the overall layout, all eight identical adult female faces and expressions, costumes, hair color, camera angle, lighting, scale, background and all other portraits. Make ONLY TWO corrections. (A) TOP ROW RIGHTMOST portrait: this hairstyle must be straight hair smoothly pulled back into a short low ponytail at the nape, NOT a braid and NOT wavy or curly, no loose curly temple strands. Show the plain compact tied tail slightly beside the neck so the ponytail shape is readable. Use only a simple plain dark leather tie. (B) BOTTOM ROW THIRD portrait FROM LEFT: replace the loose large ringlet curls with genuinely very tight, small dense coiled hair forming a compact rounded natural short afro silhouette, little individual coils very closely packed, a clear natural hairline. This hair must look distinctly different from the large loose curls in bottom row first portrait. Keep the exact same woman's face and skin tone. All other six hairstyles unchanged. Preserve clean full head silhouettes, equal framing and eight clear portraits. No text, labels, borders, decorative accessories, or additional people. Professional fantasy game character hairstyle concept art matching the original sheet.
